title: Section Formula — Coordinate Geometry
hook: Let's explore Section Formula from the chapter on Coordinate Geometry. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Section Formula The point dividing the line segment joining (x₁,y₁) and (x₂,y₂) in ratio m:n is ((mx₂+nx₁)/(m+n), (my₂+ny₁)/(m+n)). The midpoint is the special case m=n. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Internal division m:n: ((mx₂+nx₁)/(m+n), (my₂+ny₁)/(m+n))
💡 Midpoint formula (m=n=1): ((x₁+x₂)/2, (y₁+y₂)/2)
💡 Used to find centroids, medians, and points on line segments
💡 Centroid of triangle: ((x₁+x₂+x₃)/3, (y₁+y₂+y₃)/3)
